Local and international companies and developers with relevant experience are invited to participate and submit their applications. The Project scope includes the development of the headquarters site of the Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization (SASO) in Al-Muhammadiyah District in Riyadh, transforming it into an integrated mixed-use masterplan spanning over 191,000 square meters . The Project aims to create an urban destination that combines government and commercial office spaces, retail components, as well as the development of mosques, landscaped areas, roads, and pedestrian pathways. The “Quality Valley" Project seeks to optimize the utilization of state assets and achieve financial sustainability, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transformation Program. It also contributes to meeting workforce needs and consolidating government entities' operations within an advanced working environment. ncp_rows.title: MWAN and NCP Launch EOI for Development and Operation of the National Digital Waste Management Platform
ncp_rows.description: News Return to Media Center 15/04/2026 Previous Next MWAN and NCP Launch EOI for Development and Operation of the National Digital Waste Management Platform Page Image A PPP project to develop a unified digital platform enhancing waste management efficiency across the Kingdom. Page Content Riyadh: April 2026 - The National Center for Waste Management (MWAN), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture (MEWA), the Environment Fund, and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), is pleased to announce the launch of Expression of Interest (EOI) stage to develop and operate the National Digital Waste Management Platform under a PPP framework (Design, Build, Finance, Operate, Maintain, and Transfer) for a contract duration of 11 years, inviting local and global companies and investors to review the opportunity and submit their responses. This project represents a strategic milestone aimed at strengthening the planning, regulation, monitoring, and optimization of waste management activities across the Kingdom. Under the project, the private sector partner will be responsible for designing, developing, financing, operating, and maintaining a nationwide integrated digital platform, enabling effective coordination, governance, and integration across the entire waste management value chain. The project scope includes the deployment of a comprehensive suite of digital services, comprising seven (7) core business applications with twenty-seven (27) functional modules. The platform will support user and stakeholder management, customer classification, licensing systems, electronic waste tracking (e-manifest), regulatory reporting and data analytics, marketplace functionalities, and smart contracts. The platform will serve as a centralized system covering data collection, reporting, analytics, compliance monitoring, and stakeholder integration across the waste management value chain. The project aims to expand digital coverage of waste management activities, enhance operational efficiency and service quality, and streamline regulatory and compliance processes. This initiative reinforces Saudi Arabia's commitment to sustainable and efficient waste management practices and supports the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 by advancing sustainability and accelerating digital transformation within the sector. Local and international investors, financial institutions, and operators are invited to visit the MWAN website at https://mwan.gov.sa/ for more information about the project and to request the EOI document. Interested investors should submit their EOI by 6 May 2026, at 11:59 PM KSA time. ​ Share | Print

ncp_rows.title: Ministry of Sport and National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) Announce Offering of Five Additional Clubs for Privatization
ncp_rows.description: News Return to Media Center 08/06/2026 Previous Next Ministry of Sport and National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) Announce Offering of Five Additional Clubs for Privatization Page Image offering of five sports clubs to investors: Al-Riyadh, Abha, Al-Fateh, Al-Tai, and Al-Shoulla. The offering includes the receipt of expressions of interest and prequalification submissions from entities seeking to acquire these clubs Page Content ​​ The Ministry of Sport and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) announced today, Monday 8 June 2026, the offering of five sports clubs to investors: Al-Riyadh, Abha, Al-Fateh, Al-Tai, and Al-Shoulla. The offering includes the receipt of expressions of interest and prequalification submissions from entities seeking to acquire these clubs, as part of the ongoing Sports Clubs Investment and Privatization Project and efforts to open the door for the private sector to capitalize on promising opportunities within the sports sector. The Ministry revealed that the five clubs have completed all required regulatory procedures and have reached the readiness stage for offering to investors. It also noted that the deadline for receiving prequalification applications from interested investment entities is Sunday, 5 July 2026. Interested investors can submit prequalification applications through the NCP's website via the following link: investors​.ncp.gov.sa . The Ministry emphasized that sports clubs are being prepared to enter the project through a comprehensive framework that takes into account the readiness level of each club individually, as well as the seriousness and preparedness of potential investors. This approach ensures the fulfillment of all requirements necessary to participate in the project, while enhancing the efficiency of the offering process and generating sustainable value for both sports clubs and investors. The Ministry also confirmed that expressions of interest for the acquisition of any sports club remain open on an ongoing basis in accordance with the project's procedures and regulations. It noted that, where interest has been expressed in a particular club, the offering process typically takes between 8 and 10 months. The Ministry further highlighted the strong interest shown by both local and international investors in acquiring sports clubs, with more than 80 expressions of interest registered to date across 22 sports clubs. This reflects the project's rapid growth and the opportunities available for private sector entities to contribute to the continued development of the sports sector. Regarding the latest developments concerning Al-Najma and Al-Akhdoud clubs, the Ministry explained that negotiations are currently underway and will be followed by the contract-signing phase, ahead of the official announcement of the transfer of ownership of the two clubs to their new owners.​ Share | Print

ncp_rows.title: MATARAT Holding and National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) announce the launch of Request for Proposals (RFP) phase to the qualified bidders for the New Taif International Airport
ncp_rows.description: News Return to Media Center 09/06/2026 Previous Next MATARAT Holding and National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) announce the launch of Request for Proposals (RFP) phase to the qualified bidders for the New Taif International Airport Page Image The new Taif International Airport will contribute to the economic development of Taif city and its surrounding areas, in line with the National Aviation Strategy, as a highly efficient airport offering top-quality passenger experience. Page Content Riyadh, June 2026: MATARAT Holding and the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP) are pleased to announce the launch of the Request for Proposals (RFP) for the new Taif International Airport project. This invitation is open to interested private sector entities in a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model under a Build-Transfer-Operate (BTO) contract for a period of 30 years inclusive of the construction period. This Project is in line with Vision 2030's goals, which aims to enhance the growth of the aviation sector in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Through the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and the National Aviation Strategy, the Kingdom seeks to strengthen its position among the leading nations as a global logistics hub connecting three continents. The new Taif International Airport will be located 21 km southeast of the existing Taif Airport, with a capacity to accommodate 2.5 million passengers by 2030. The Project scope includes (BTO) model of the new airport. The proposed design features a runway with a full-length-parallel taxiway, that connects to a single commercial apron. The new Taif International Airport will include a well-equipped commercial passenger terminal building aligned with the airport's projected capacity and demand, along with facility buildings, utility networks, car parks, and access roads that enable the standard operation of the airport. The project includes additional expansions to meet future subsystem requirements. The new Taif International Airport is expected to meet the projected increase in demand by 2055. It is also expected to meet the needs of Umrah pilgrims as a viable alternative within the region's multi-airport system. This system includes King Abdulaziz Airport in Jeddah, Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Airport in Madinah, and Prince Abdulmohsen bin Abdulaziz Airport in Yanbu. The new Taif International Airport will contribute to the economic development of Taif city and its surrounding areas, in line with the National Aviation Strategy, as a highly efficient airport offering top-quality passenger experience. ​ ​ Share | Print

Furthermore, the development will integrate services with surrounding projects to address community needs, deliver essential services, and support ongoing population growth. ncp_rows.title: RFQ Launched for King Fahd Suburb Boulevard PPP Project in Eastern Province
ncp_rows.description: News Return to Media Center 27/08/2026 Previous Next RFQ Launched for King Fahd Suburb Boulevard PPP Project in Eastern Province Page Image Spanning approximately 1,000,000 m², the project will be developed in two phases, with a balanced allocation of a development plots, green spaces, and infrastructure facilities. Page Content Riyadh, August 2026 ​ – The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing (MOMAH), the National Center for Privatization & PPP (NCP), and Ashraq Development Company, the development arm of the Eastern Province Municipality, are pleased to announce the launch of the Request for Qualification (RFQ) phase for the King Fahd Suburb Boulevard Project in the Eastern Province. This Public-Private Partnership (PPP) project will be delivered under a Design, Build, Finance, Operate, Maintain, and Transfer (DBFOMT) model, with a contract term of 43 years. Located in Al Bayda Governorate in the Eastern Province, the project spans approximately 1,000,000 m² and will be developed in two phases, with a balanced allocation of development plots, green spaces, and infrastructure facilities. The project also features a 4 km integrated mixed-use zone along a central boulevard and linear parklands, forming part of a larger 7.3 km corridor. Leveraging its strategic location and potential to deliver a unique urban experience, the private sector partner will be responsible for developing and operating a comprehensive mixed-use environment. This will include leisure and recreational facilities, public parks, entertainment venues, retail outlets, office spaces, and road networks—all designed to foster a vibrant environment in the Eastern Province. ​​The project is poised to redefine the urban landscape of the King Fahd Suburb in Dammam, advancing Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 goals to enhance quality of life, drive sustainable development, and increase private sector participation in municipal infrastructure. For more information about the project, interested parties can visit the Investors Portal on the NCP website at: www.Investors.ncp.gov.sa For inquiries or submissions, you may reach out via email at kingfahadblvd@ashraq.sa The deadline for submitting the Statement of Qualification (SOQ) is 22 October 2026 at 11:59​ Share | Print

all_current_unmerged_masters.title_ar: تطوير وتشغيل الخزن الاستراتيجي للمياه: فرصة للشراكة بين القطاع العام والخاص
all_current_unmerged_masters.title_en: Development and Operation of Strategic Water Storage Tanks – PPP Investment Opportunity
all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
تماشيًا مع خطة التخصيص المعتمدة من المركز الوطني للتخصيص، تعمل الهيئة الملكية على تطوير منظومة استراتيجية لتخزين مياه الشرب، بهدف ضمان استدامة وموثوقية إمدادات المياه، ودعم النمو الاقتصادي والسياحي والاحتياجات المستقبلية للمحافظة.
يشمل المشروع إنشاء وتشغيل خمسة خزانات استراتيجية بسعة إجمالية تبلغ 295,000 م³، بما يوفر احتياطيًا من مياه الشرب يكفي لنحو 3 إلى 4 أيام، بالإضافة إلى محطات الضخ وشبكات الربط والمرافق الداعمة، لخدمة المناطق الحضرية والمواقع التراثية والمطار ومناطق التطوير الجديدة.من المخطط تنفيذ المشروع وفق نموذج التصميم والبناء والتمويل والتشغيل والصيانة، بمدة امتياز تبلغ نحو 15 عامًا، تشمل 2 إلى 3 سنوات للإنشاء و12 إلى 13 عامًا للتشغيل والصيانة، وبآلية مدفوعات قائمة على الإتاحة والأداء وجودة المياه.
من المتوقع طرح طلب تقديم العروض في الربع الرابع من عام 2027، على أن يتم إنجاز المشروع على مراحل حتى عام 2031.

all_current_unmerged_masters.title_ar: مشاريع توسعة الطرق الرئيسية - فرصة استثمارية للشراكة بين القطاع العام والخاص
all_current_unmerged_masters.title_en: Expansion of Highways and Primary Roads – PPP investment opportunity
all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
تماشيًا مع خطة التخصيص المعتمدة من المركز الوطني للتخصيص، تعمل الهيئة الملكية على تطوير وتحديث شبكة الطرق الرئيسية بهدف تعزيز الربط ودعم النمو الاقتصادي والسياحي  في العلا
يشمل المشروع تطوير وتحديث خمسة طرق رئيسية وشبكات المرافق والخدمات التابعة، بإجمالي أطوال 204 كيلومترات، بما في ذلك الإنشاء وإعادة التأهيل، وتوفير مسارات للدراجات الهوائية، وتطبيق إجراءات تهدئة الحركة المرورية، إلى جانب تطوير البنية التحتية المتكاملة لشبكات المياه والكهرباء والاتصالات وتصريف مياه الأمطار
من المخطط تنفيذ المشروع وفق نموذج التصميم والبناء والتمويل والتشغيل والصيانة بآلية مدفوعات قائمة على الإتاحة، ومدة امتياز 15 عامًا. ويقتصر نطاق التشغيل والصيانة على الطرق، على أن تُسلّم شبكات المرافق والخدمات إلى الجهات المختصة
من المخطط البدء في طرح طلبات تقديم العروض للحزم في بداية 2028، على أن يتم إنجاز المشروع على مراحل حتى 2032

all_current_unmerged_masters.title_ar: تحسين وتشغيل محطات معالجة مياه الصرف الصحي: فرصة للشراكة بين القطاع العام والخاص
all_current_unmerged_masters.title_en: Enhancement and operation of Wastewater Treatment Plants – PPP Investment Opportunity
all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
تماشيًا مع خطة التخصيص المعتمدة من المركز الوطني للتخصيص، تعمل الهيئة الملكية على إعادة تأهيل وتوسعة محطة معالجة مياه الصرف الصحي لتعزيز الطاقة الاستيعابية، ودعم النمو الاقتصادي، بما يحقق الاستدامة البيئية.

يشمل المشروع إعادة تأهيل المحطة القائمة بطاقة 8,000 م³/يوميا، وتوسعتها باستخدام تقنية المفاعل الحيوي ذي الحشوات المتحركة على مرحلتين، بطاقة 18,000 م³/يومياً للمرحلة الأولى، و36,000 م³/يومياً للمرحلة الثانية، لتصل الطاقة الإجمالية إلى 62,000 م³/يومياً ، بالإضافة إلى مرافق تخزين وضخ المياه المعالجة، وأنظمة التحكم والمرافق الداعمة.
من المخطط تنفيذ المشروع وفق نموذج البناء والتملك والتشغيل ونقل الملكية ، بمدة امتياز تبلغ نحو 26 عامًا، تشمل 3 سنوات للإنشاء وإعادة التأهيل و23 عامًا للتشغيل، وبآلية مدفوعات قائمة على الطاقة الاستيعابية والإنتاج ومدفوعات تكميلية.
من المتوقع طرح طلب تقديم العروض في الربع الثاني من عام 2027.

all_current_unmerged_masters.title_ar: AL AHSA HEALTHCARE WASTE TREATMENT CENTER
all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
The opportunity aims to operate a healthcare waste treatment infrastructure across all Al Ahsa cluster.

Driven by the Covid-19 health crisis, medical waste has increased to 2.6 
M tons per day worldwide

Healthcare waste management market globally had a revenue of USD 
12.8 bn in 2021. It is expected to be growing at a CAGR of 6.9% during 
the forecast period (2022-2030)

Market dynamics are also driven by the increasing use of reusable 
surgical products and rising awareness programs for medical waste 
management in developed countries

The project would require healthcare waste provided from 
public and private healthcare providers and transported to the 
facilities through waste collection and transfer operators in Al 
Ahsa Cluster

Expansion and modernization of the healthcare sector are 
increasing the demand for healthcare waste management 
services

Growth in economic and population in KSA and further 
expansion of Al Ahsa are additional demand drivers and 
are projected

all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
The project aims to establish an inert landfill facility for construction and demolition waste in Al Ahsa.

The global construction and demolition waste management 
market size was $115 billion in 2020. The market is expected 
to reach $542.7 billion in 2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% of the 
total waste produced worldwide and is expected to grow at a 
rate of 3.2 billion tons per year until 2025

The main input to the operation comes from the 
Construction and Demolition Treatment facility for 
final disposal.

Al Ahsa's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions

10.4% from 2021 to 2031 


cross the value of USD 2.3 T by the end of 2031

Industrial waste constitutes approximately half of the share of the 
overall waste generated across the globe

The operation would mainly require a continuous input of hazardous 
industrial waste from private waste collectors. This opportunity also 
receives waste from other streams such as agricultural, healthcare 
and ELV waste.

all_current_unmerged_masters.title_ar: AL AHSA CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION WASTE TREATMENT FACILITY 3
all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
The project is aiming to establish a fixed facility for construction and demolition waste (CDW) treatment, offering services in Al Ahsa

The global construction and demolition waste 
management market size was $115 billion in 2020. 
The market is expected to reach $542.7 billion in 
2028, with a CAGR of 5.1%

Construction and demolition waste accounts for 30% 
of the total waste produced worldwide and is 
expected to grow at a rate of 3.2 billion tons per year 
until 2025

The opportunity relies on a constant inflow of construction and 
demolition coming from private CDW collectors

Al Ahsa's population growth and expansion are the 
main drivers of construction and demolition waste 
generation

The increase in personal income and government 
incentives for homeownership

The Vision 2030 initiative includes the development 
of the infrastructure sector, which is expected to 
lead to an increase in waste generation 
necessitating further waste management solutions

all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
تماشيًا مع خطة التخصيص المعتمدة من المركز الوطني للتخصيص، تعمل الهيئة الملكية لمحافظة العلا على توسعة مطار العلا الدولي لدعم النمو السياحي وتعزيز الربط الجوي للعلا

يشمل المشروع مبنى ركاب جديدًا بمساحة تقارب 30 ألف م² وبطاقة استيعابية تصل إلى 3 ملايين مسافر سنويًا، ومبنى للشحن الجوي بمساحة 5 آلاف م² يضم مرافق مخصصة للخيول والفروسية  وفق أعلى المعاييرالعالمية، ومبنى للطيران الخاص بمساحة تقارب 10 آلاف م²، ومرافق للطيران العام والمروحيات، وتمديد المدرج إلى 3 آلاف متر، إضافة إلى الطرق ومواقف السيارات ومرافق الصيانة والخدمات والوقود

كما تتوفر نحو مليون م² من الأراضي لاستخدامات تجارية مكملة، تشمل الخدمات اللوجستية والتجزئة والضيافة وخدمات الطيران

من المخطط تنفيذ المشروع بنظام البناء–النقل–التشغيل، بمدة امتياز تصل إلى 35 عامًا.

ومن المتوقع طرح طلب تقديم العروض في الربع الثالث من عام 2027، وإنجاز المشروع بحلول عام 2032.

all_current_unmerged_masters.title_en: Development and Operation of a Solid Waste Management System – PPP Investment Opportunity
all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
تماشيًا مع خطة التخصيص المعتمدة من المركز الوطني للتخصيص، تعمل الهيئة الملكية على تطوير منظومة متكاملة لإدارة النفايات الصلبة في العُلا، بهدف تعزيز الاستدامة البيئية، وزيادة معدلات إعادة التدوير، ودعم الاقتصاد المستدام 
يشمل المشروع تطوير مجمع لإدارة المواد ومحطة لنقل النفايات بطاقة 76 ألف طن سنويًا، ومرافق لإعادة التدوير بطاقة 45 ألف طن سنويًا، ومعالجة النفايات العضوية، ومخلفات البناء والهدم بطاقة 220 ألف طن سنويًا، إلى جانب خلايا ردم هندسية بسعة 5 ملايين متر مكعب، والمرافق الداعمة.
من المخطط تنفيذ المشروع وفق نموذج التصميم والبناء والتمويل والتشغيل والصيانة، بمدة امتياز تبلغ 30 عامًا، تشمل 3 سنوات للإنشاء و27 عامًا للتشغيل، وبآلية مدفوعات قائمة على الأداء ورسوم استقبال ونقل النفايات.
من المخطط طرح طلب تقديم العروض في الربع الثاني من عام 2027.

all_current_unmerged_masters.description:
تماشيًا مع خطة التخصيص المعتمدة من المركز الوطني للتخصيص، تعمل الهيئة الملكية على تطوير شبكة الطرق الثانوية بهدف تعزيز الربط ودعم النمو الاقتصادي والسياحي العلا. وتسهيل الوصول إلى مناطق التطوير الجديدة والمواقع التراثية والمحميات الطبيعية.
يشمل المشروع تطوير 18 مسارًا للطرق الثانوية وشبكات المرافق والخدمات، بإجمالي أطوال يبلغ نحو 1,400 كيلومتر، بما في ذلك إنشاء طرق جديدة وتطوير البنية التحتية المتكاملة لشبكات المياه والكهرباء والاتصالات وإنارة الطرق وتصريف مياه الأمطار.
من المخطط تنفيذ المشروع وفق نموذج التصميم والبناء والتمويل والتشغيل والصيانة بآلية مدفوعات قائمة على الإتاحة، ومدة امتياز تبلغ نحو 20 عامًا. ويقتصر نطاق التشغيل والصيانة على الطرق فقط، على أن تُسلّم شبكات المرافق والخدمات إلى الجهات المختصة.
من المخطط البدء في طرح طلبات تقديم العروض للحزم في بداية 2028، على أن يتم إنجاز المشروع على مراحل حتى 2033
